  List page using {title, toolbar, children, empty} works in 1 step. It returns shows a <main> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-4' containing a <h1> with class name as 'text-2xl font-bold' containing title and if toolbar then a <div> with class name as 'flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4' containing toolbar, otherwise nothing and if children then a <div> with class name as 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' containing children, otherwise empty.
- pages/DetailPage (library/pages/DetailPage.tsx), in English:
  Detail page using {title, back, children, aside} works in 1 step. It returns shows a <main> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-4' containing back and a <h1> with class name as 'text-2xl font-bold' containing title and a <div> with class name as 'grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]' containing a <section> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-3' containing children and if aside then a <aside> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-3' containing aside, otherwise nothing.
- pages/FormPage (library/pages/FormPage.tsx), in English:
  Form page using {title, on submit, submit label, children, aside} works in 2 steps. Let submit be e prevent default, then on submit. It returns shows a <main> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-4' containing a <h1> with class name as 'text-2xl font-bold' containing title and a <div> with class name as 'grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]' containing a <form> with no validate and on submit as submit and class name as 'flex flex-col gap-4' and aria-label as title containing children and a <Button> with type as 'submit' and label as submit label and if aside then a <aside> with class name as 'flex flex-col gap-3' containing aside, otherwise nothing.

- BRW-1: The page at `/` has the main heading "Library catalogue" and shows the books six at a time, each with its title, its author, its genre, its year and "Available" or "On loan"; each title is a link to the book's page at `/books/<id>`.
- BRW-2: Under the list, a line like "Page 1 of 3" and two buttons, "Previous page" and "Next page", move through the pages; "Previous page" is disabled on the first page and "Next page" on the last.
